summary: Master arbitration, mediation, and ADR with practical case tools, clause drafting, and settlement workflows. Enrol to sharpen dispute handling.
lede: Arbitration and dispute resolution training helps professionals assess disputes and choose an appropriate route to resolve them. Designed for people handling claims, grievances, or contract friction, it develops practical skills in case triage, mediation planning, arbitration clause drafting, and preparing settlement documents and reports for decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who already deal with disputes, grievances, claims, or contract friction and now need a more disciplined way to manage mediation and arbitration work. It is aimed at professionals who want practical case handling, clearer clauses, stronger settlement documentation, and better reporting for leaders.
prerequisites: Bring a laptop for document review, clause drafting, and case-file exercises. Participants should arrive with basic experience in contracts, disputes, negotiation, compliance, or HR case handling, and a willingness to work through realistic scenario materials.
